meta.title: Humor Intelligence Test
meta.note: Three timed workplace-humor challenges. Each pairs one slide, one headline, and one prompt.

items.headline: Company announces fourth reorganization this year
items.setup: Things not to say on your first day at a new job
items.image_alt: Training slide titled Our Organizational Structure showing a hierarchy from Chief Executive through VPs and Directors to Everyone Else, with the line: Clear reporting lines create accountability.

items.headline: CEO returns from leadership retreat with bold new vision
items.setup: Worst names for a conference room
items.image_alt: Training slide titled Work-Life Balance listing: Your wellbeing is our top priority; Disconnect fully after work hours; Please continue to monitor email for urgent items; Use your vacation days. You have earned them.

items.headline: Firm replaces annual performance reviews with quarterly performance reviews
items.setup: Rejected themes for the annual holiday party
items.image_alt: Training slide titled Giving Constructive Feedback listing: Be specific, timely, and objective; Focus on the behavior, not the person; Use the feedback sandwich: praise, critique, praise; End with a clear action step.
